programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Keisha Knight Pulliam, Ming-Na, Chi McBride, Mia Tyler
programme.desc: Keisha Knight Pulliam encounters a lingering family spirit; while making renovations on her new house, Ming-Na discovers a previous owner is reluctant to leave.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Brett Butler, Cassandra Peterson, Phil Varone, Ana Gasteyer
programme.desc: A protective spirit saves Brett Butler from an abusive relationship; a murdered man threatens Cassandra Peterson's life in her own home; lonely spirits stalk Phil Varone.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Patti Stanger
programme.desc: Millionaire Matchmaker Patti Stanger reluctantly returns to her former dream home in Marina Del Rey where she was attacked in her bed by an aggressive spirit.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Audrina Patridge
programme.desc: Reality star and host Audrina Patridge returns to an historic pub in Chicago where she was accosted by an angry spirit. Their journey takes an unexpected turn as Psycic Medium Kim Russo uncovers more of Audrina's story.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: T-Pain
programme.desc: Music Mogul and rapper T-Pain seeks psychic medium Kim Russo's help in uncovering what is causing the terrifying paranormal activity in his family's home in Roswell, Georgia.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksassistent støder på en mystisk plante med sult efter blod. Succes følger, men prisen viser sig at være menneskeliv, og situationen eskalerer.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: John Grisham's The Rainmaker
programme.desc: En ung idealistisk advokat tager en sag om en fattig familie, hvis søn bliver nægtet hjælp af et stort forsikringsselskab og dør, og afslører forsikringssvindel for milliarder af dollar.

programme.title: Birdman
programme.desc: For at bevise sit værd risikerer en tidligere filmhelt alt. I sin kamp mod forskelige kritikere, et alter ego, sin datter og en skuespiller stræber han efter at komme ud af middelmådigheden.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: Da en klog sort hustler fra South Central i Los Angeles bliver transporteret tilbage til middelalderens England, leder han omstyrtelsen af en ond konge og vinder en protofeministisk kvindes hjerte.

programme.title: Tully
programme.desc: 'Tully' er skrevet og instrueret af skaberne af den højtelskede Oscar-vinder 'Juno'. Skrevet af Diablo Cody (Young Adult) og instrueret af Jason Reitman (Thank You for Smoking, Up in the Air og Young Adult).

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksassistent støder på en mystisk plante med sult efter blod. Succes følger, men prisen viser sig at være menneskeliv, og situationen eskalerer.

programme.title: The Golden Child
programme.desc: Murphy er som 'Den udvalgte' på en vild mission for at redde The Golden Child, et barn med mystiske kræfter, som er blevet bortført af en ondskabsfuld kult.

programme.title: Eye in the Sky
programme.desc: Helen Mirren, Aaron Paul og Alan Rickman medvirker i denne politiske spændingsfilm. Ved en militæroperation har man chancen for at dræbe tre fremtrædende terrorister, men etikken komplicerer tingene.

programme.title: Taken 2
programme.desc: Den tidligere CIA agent, Bryan Mills, reddede for et år siden sin datter fra en brutal trafficking-mafia. Men intet er glemt og intet er tilgivet, for nu vil faderen til et af Bryans ofre have hævn.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Legenden om de fortabte
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel tager af sted for at finde ud af, om legenden om den forsvundne civilisation på Ny Guinea er sand. Desværre må de slå sig sammen med Derek Lloyd.

programme.title: Andromeda: Una Salus Victus
programme.desc: Andromeda har til opgave at eskortere medicinske skibe sikkert gennem Drago-Kazov-rummet

programme.title: Andromeda: Hjemmefester
programme.desc: En planet med overlevende fra Commonwealth, som ledes af Dylans tidligere forlovede, bliver inviteret til at slutte sig til det nye Commonwealth.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ind i labyrinten
programme.desc: En agent fra Abyss forsøger at lokke Harper til at slutte sig til Magog.

programme.title: Andromeda: Prinsen
programme.desc: Da de redder en ung prins fra et oprør, der dræber resten af hans familie, bliver Dylan og Tyr bedt om at blive hans rådgivere.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1980 the FBI faced the largest explosive device they had ever seen. The bomb was sophisticated, carefully constructed, and designed to destroy an entire building.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Target
programme.desc: Over a thousand hunting accidents are reported in the United States each year. Fewer than ten percent of them are fatal. But when one hunter's death seemed suspicious, the FBI was called in to investigate.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In the Camera's Eye
programme.desc: Photography has long been a vital tool in homicide investigations. A single image captures enough information to identify a suspect, and to preserve a vital clue long after a witness' memory fades.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Wasted Youth
programme.desc: When teenagers are driven to kill, their victims are but the first to fall. In three such cases, the families of the killers, as well as their communities, become the victims of violent crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Collective Justice
programme.desc: Philadelphia's Vidocq Society, named after an 18th Century French detective, is one of the world's most unusual crime-solving organizations.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder For Hire
programme.desc: For some killers, murder can be a profitable business. And the scene of the crime can be both a source for clues, and puzzling questions. When a victim has been targeted for death, investigators must look beyond the obvious to uncover a murder for hire.

programme.title: The Roast of James Franco

programme.title: The Roast of Roseanne Barr

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Caesar and Me

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Encounter

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Karina Smirnoff
programme.desc: Psychic Medium Kim Russo helps Dancing With The Stars Karina Smirnoff confront the ghosts who are terrorizing her family in their Woodland Hills, California home.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Mill – Part 1
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Stockport and investigate an abandoned Mill, Weir Mill, said to the most haunted Mill in the UK. Demonic figures haunt anyone that enters. Will the team survive the night with the spirits?

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Mill – Part 2
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters continue their investigation of Weir Mill and the search for paranormal activity takes a darker turn. Will they finally uncover the truth behind the buildings dark hauntings?

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Bulkeley Hotel
programme.desc: The former home of Queen Victoria is now home to many spirits who have been seen by guests and staff. Witness the first ever formal documentation of the paranormal activities in the Bulkeley Hotel.

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: The Ghoul
programme.desc: A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead. The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

programme.title: Vores livs ferie
programme.desc: Oplev de to Oscarvindere, Helen Mirren og Donald Sutherland, i en forrygende og moden roadmovie, der både leverer gode grin og stof til eftertanke.

programme.title: Colette
programme.desc: I 1900-tallets Paris presses Colette af sin mand til at skrive bøger i hans navn. Da bøgerne bliver en succes, forråder han hende, og hun må kæmpe for at få en stemme i en mandsdomineret forfatterverden samt den anerkendelse, som hun fortjener.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: Upside of Anger
programme.desc: Den midaldrende husmor Terrys liv bliver vendt på hovedet, da hendes mand pludselig flytter til Sverige med sin sekretær. Snart begynder Terry at føle sig tiltrukket af mandens bedste ven, den tidligere baseballstjerne Denny.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Nogen er gået for vidt med din kærlighed til efterfølgere! Favoritfigurerne fra SCARY MOVIE er tilbage i en film, der skræmmer til mere uærbødig morskab end originalen med sin version af kliche-spøgelsesfilm.

programme.title: My Best Friend's Girl
programme.desc: Tank (Dane Cook) står over for den ultimative venskabsprøve, da hans bedste ven (Jason Biggs) hyrer ham til at tage hans eks (Kate Hudson) med på en skidt date for at få hende til at indse, hvor god en kæreste han er.

programme.title: Pas på, politiet kommer
programme.desc: Slagsbrødrene Wilbur Walsh (Bud Spencer) og Matt Kirby (Terence Hill) slår pjalterne sammen og planlægger at røve et supermarked, men planen går så skævt, at de to småforbrydere i stedet ender med at melde sig ind i politikorpset!

programme.title: Notorious
programme.desc: Datteren af en dømt nazistisk spion bliver bedt af amerikanske agenter om at indsamle oplysninger om en ring af nazistiske videnskabsmænd i Sydamerika. Hvor langt skal hun gå for at infiltrere dem?

programme.title: American Siege
programme.desc: Den afdankede sherif i en lille by i Georgia, Ben Watts, bliver presset til hurtigt at løse en gidselsituation – og indser snart, at han er en brik i et større spil blandt byens skumle hemmeligheder.

programme.title: Fortress: Sniper's Eye
programme.desc: Den pensionerede CIA-agent Robert kaster sig ud i en vovemodig redningsaktion af sin ærkefjendes enke, Sasha. Men snart konfronteres Robert med et velkendt ansigt, som han troede, han aldrig skulle se igen...

programme.title: Mutant X: sjælens korsvej
programme.desc: Holdet tager af sted for at redde Brennan, der er blevet fanget i en usynlig by og står over for at blive henrettet for en forbrydelse, han ikke har begået.

programme.title: Mutant X: tegn fra oven
programme.desc: Tre rumvæsener, der udgør en alvorlig trussel mod menneskeheden, har Shalimar som mål, så holdet tager af sted for at redde hende fra deres onde kløer.

programme.title: Mutant X: krop og sjæl
programme.desc: En kropsløs mutant overtager forskellige menneskers kroppe og sætter sig for at gå efter dem, der har gjort det mod ham. En af dem er en læge, som Shalimar kan lide.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Under et arbejde bliver Shalimar såret og får hjælp af en anden vild mutant, Nikki, som hun kendte og næsten var blevet valgt til holdet. Mens Shalimar kommer til hægterne, tilbyder hun at vikariere.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Dødens Dolk
programme.desc: Indien, 500 e.Kr: En kostbar dolk bruges til menneskeofringer til gudinden Kali. Sydney skal returnere et levn til Indien for sin jægerkollega, som tror, at dolken fik ham til at dræbe sin assistent.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Vanished
programme.desc: A daring kidnapping and a bizarre ransom note baffled Mississippi authorities. The victim was the wife of a wealthy businessman. A list of 12 names and a few drops of blood were the only clues to her fate.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Search For Lisa Rene
programme.desc: When a young woman was grabbed from her Texas home, the police raced to find her abductors. On the face of it, the kidnapping seemed like the random act of desperate men.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Boston, FBI agents and local police tracked a gang of robbers who specialized in armored car takedowns. Their MO was familiar. The gang used precise timing to steal millions in cash and burned their getaway cars to destroy evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Toxic Death
programme.desc: Sometimes, the cause of death does not match the scene of the crime. When an untraceable poison is used to commit murder, homicide detectives turn to forensic toxicologists to follow a killer's tracks and expose a toxic death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Material Witness
programme.desc: Lies and deceit can often throw investigators off the trail of justice. But when hard evidence contradicts a killer's story, police must use the clues to piece together the truth.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Betrayed
programme.desc: Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Elements Of Murder
programme.desc: There are several things that can suggest murder; jealousy, anger, poison. When everyday substances reveal hidden clues that break a homicide case, those substances become the elements of murder.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Plas Teg
programme.desc: The county of Flintshire in Wales is said to be a land filled with ghosts and haunts. Plas Teg is said to be one of the "most haunted" houses in the area. With over 400 years of history, this place is sure to be the home of many an entity.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Augusta is home to Kentucky’s oldest jail, which housed prisoners since the early 1800s and still sits upon its original foundation today. While it now operates as a museum, there have been numerous guests who have claimed to see unexplainable things.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The oldest, and longest running movie theatre in Kentucky is now owned and operated by someone who never once thought about ghosts. However, a shocking experience with a woman dressed in white altered his belief in the supernatural forever.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: A longtime fixture of the paranormal investigative landscape, Mackey’s has developed a reputation for being one of America’s creepiest haunts, supposedly hosting a dark energy that can leave some investigators mentally scarred.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Kentucky is home to a slew of purportedly haunted locations, with some that are more notorious than others. By all local accounts, the Benton farmhouse should be considered one of the state’s most significant haunts.

programme.title: The Raven (1963)
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: On the road
programme.desc: Dean og Sal er unge, oprørske amerikanere i 1940’erne. De nægter at indordne sig under samfundets konformitet og i deres søgen efter en identitet tager de på road-trip tværs over USA.

programme.title: Teaching Mrs. Tingle
programme.desc: Leigh Anns (Katie Holmes) drømme om et legat ødelægges, da hendes lærer, fru Tingle, med urette beskylder hende for at snyde. Da hun er desperat for at bevise sin uskyld, lægger Leigh Ann planer, der skal lære fru Tingle en lektie.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Backstage Murder
programme.desc: In the 1980's, two partners created a nightclub that would bring them wealth and international fame. The male strip club phenomenon promised female patrons fun and excitement. But the bright lights hid a dark side.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hidden Agenda
programme.desc: Across the Midwest, a band of armed robbers struck banks at the rate of nearly one per month. They attacked with lightning precision and lethal force. They were in and out in five minutes.

programme.title: Også engle spiser bønner
programme.desc: Charlie er fribryder i forbudstidens New York, og han nægter at være med til at fikse en kamp, og gangsterbossen Angelo har satset penge på modstanderen. Han bliver nødt til at flygte, og under flugten støder han på Sonny, der også er på flugt.

programme.title: Magic in the Moonlight
programme.desc: Stanley Crawford (Colin Firth) er tryllekunstner, men skeptisk overfor det overnaturlige. Han møder den clairvoyante Sophie Baker (Emma Stone) og skal afsløre hendes tricks, men kan ikke finde nogen. Er der mon mere mellem himmel og jord?

programme.title: Explorers
programme.desc: In their makeshift laboratory, three boys use an amazing discovery and their ingenuity to build their own spaceship and launch themselves on a fantastic interplanetary journey.

programme.title: Fingrene væk fra øen
programme.desc: Terence Hill og Bud Spencer er tilbage i den vildeste skattejagtskomedie. I håbet om at finde en begravet skat på en øde ø, prøver Hill at stikke af med Spencers båd, men efter et slagsmål ender de begge i vandet.

programme.title: Behaving Badly
programme.desc: Rick Stevens er villig til at gøre alt for at vinde Nina Penningtons hjerte. Selv hvis det betyder at indgå et væddemål med en gangster søn.

programme.title: Farvel til mafiaen
programme.desc: En mafia boss og hans familie er flyttet til en søvnig by i Frankrig, som en del af vidne beskyttelsesprogrammet, efter de vidnede mod mafiaen.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Mochicas sidste
programme.desc: På jagt efter et sydamerikansk mochica-indisk relikvie til beskyttelse bliver Nigel og hans kolleger taget til fange af lokale guerillaer. Det er op til Sydney og hans allierede Jason Clark at redde dem.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Frugtbar jord
programme.desc: Sydney genforenes med sin high school-kæreste for at finde et hawaiiansk frugtbarhedsidol i Madagaskar.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Gypsy Jigsaw
programme.desc: Sydney modtager et sæt sjældne tarotkort fra sin nyligt afdøde veninde. Den berygtede, hidtil uomtalte Vulture var efter ham. Sydney får Claudia til at hjælpe.

programme.title: Andromeda: Bunker Hill
programme.desc: Dylan og hans nye flåde fra Commonwealth tager kampen op mod Drago-Kazov-flåden, men finder den meget større end forventet.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the late 1970s, the FBI had a working knowledge of anti-Castro terrorists operating in the United States. But then a new group appeared, more violent and aggressive than their predecessors.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: The United States is one of the most profitable drug markets in the world. For ruthless and sophisticated drug traffickers, it is truly the land of opportunity.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Random Targets
programme.desc: Most victims of multiple murderers are meticulously chosen because of a mutual connection with the killer or because they match an intricate set of criteria that fits the killer's MO.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Grave Secrets
programme.desc: Killers often attempt to deflect attention away from their crimes by hiding the remains of their victims. Bodies may lay hidden for years before they are discovered.

programme.title: The New Detectives: At Close Range
programme.desc: When a victim is gunned down at point-blank range, police often assume that a friend or acquaintance is to blame.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Encounter
programme.desc: In most homicides, police rely on motive to pursue a murderer. But when the killer is a stranger the crime may go unsolved for years. It takes a full arsenal of forensic techniques to trace a lethal encounter.

programme.desc: Joan Osborne is attacked by the ghost of a woman with a painful history.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Dyan Cannon, Wendi McLendon-Covey, Quinton Aaron, Bridget Marquardt
programme.desc: A young Dyan Cannon is visited in the night by a guardian spirit. Wendi McLendon-Covey has a paranormal encounter after a walk through a cemetery. Quinton Aaron encounters.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Alan Thicke, Fairuza Balk, Kevin Pollak, Laila Ali
programme.desc: Alan Thicke and his son encounter a murderous Russian ghost while visiting Moscow. On her first trip to Los Angeles alone, sixteen year old Fairuza Balk is attacked by an evil.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Loretta Lynn
programme.desc: Country music superstar Loretta Lynn, the "Queen of Country," invites viewers into her legendary, and HAUNTED, Tennessee estate. In this exclusive and highly personal special.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: Howard Stern'S Edle Deler
programme.desc: Edle Deler følger Howard Sterns fantastiske transformasjon fra skolenerd til mediesuperstjerne.

programme.title: Watching the Detectives
programme.desc: Neil er en skikkelig filmfrik som eier en liten videobutikk. Når han ikke sitter som naglet fast foran fjernsynsapparatet og en eller annen film noir, diskuterer han film med de to medarbeiderne sine, supernerden Lucien og den noe mer stabile Jonathan.

programme.title: Impact Earth
programme.desc: En astronomiprofessor med NASA-bakgrunn gjør en skremmende oppdagelse om at en destruktiv asteroide er på kollisjonskurs med jorda, og han må få familien i trygghet mens han varsler verden om den kommende ødeleggelsen.

programme.title: The Fountain
programme.desc: Hugh Jackman og Oscar®-vinneren Rachel Weisz spiller hovedrollene i regissør Darren Aronofskys tidløse fabel om en manns søken etter Livets tre.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Nesten tjue år etter at kult-serien Galaxy Quest ble kansellert, ber romvesener besetningen om hjelp til å redde universet.

programme.title: Watching the Detectives
programme.desc: Neil er en skikkelig filmfrik som eier en liten videobutikk. Når han ikke sitter som naglet fast foran fjernsynsapparatet og en eller annen film noir, diskuterer han film med de to medarbeiderne sine, supernerden Lucien og den noe mer stabile Jonathan.

programme.title: Hjemme i Hampstead
programme.desc: En amerikansk enke i London innleder et forhold til en mann som oppholder seg i Hampstead Heath, men en hensynsløs entreprenør vil få ham vekk derfra.

programme.title: American Siege
programme.desc: Den avdankede sheriffen i en liten by i Georgia, Ben Watts, blir presset til raskt å løse en gisselsituasjon – og innser snart at han er en brikke i et større spill blant byens skumle hemmeligheter.

programme.title: Wim Wenders Collection: Far Away So Close
programme.desc: En gruppe engler i den tyske hovedstaden ser med lengsel på menneskers liv.

programme.title: Number 17
programme.desc: En gjeng tyver samles i et trygt hus etter et ran, men en detektiv er på sporet deres.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Last of the Mochicas
programme.desc: På jakt etter et søramerikansk Mochica-indisk beskyttelsesrester, blir Nigel og hans kolleger fanget av lokale geriljaer. Det er opp til Sydney og alliert Jason Clark å redde dem.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Fertile Ground
programme.desc: Sydney gjenforenes med kjæresten på videregående skole for å spore et hawaiisk fruktbarhetsidol på Madagaskar.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Gypsy Jigsaw
programme.desc: Sydney mottar et kort sjeldne Tarot-kort fra sin nylig avdøde venn. Den beryktede, tidligere nevnte Gribben var etter ham. Sydney verver Claudia til å hjelpe.

programme.title: Andromeda: Una Salus Victus
programme.desc: Andromeda har til oppgave å eskortere medisinske skip trygt gjennom Drago-Kazov-rommet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hjemmebranner
programme.desc: En planet av Commonwealth-overlevende ledet av Dylans tidligere forlovede blir invitert til å bli med i det nye Commonwealth, men når de stemmer for ikke å bli med, blir Magog mistenkt for å ha spilt skittent.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Without Mercy
programme.desc: Despite what you see in the movies, most bank robbers come in quietly, pass a note, and slip away. They want cash, not bloodshed. But in Richmond, Virginia, a pair of gunmen entered a bank with their guns blazing.

programme.title: The FBI Files: No Remorse
programme.desc: A burning body in a dark alley shed light on a cold-blooded killer. His partners in crime would tell the story, if they lived. In the underworld of the drug trade, even a childhood friend can quickly become an enemy.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Target
programme.desc: Over a thousand hunting accidents are reported in the United States each year. Fewer than ten percent of them are fatal. But when one hunter's death seemed suspicious, the FBI was called in to investigate.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Undaunted
programme.desc: Solving crimes may begin with gut intuition, but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof. When criminals go to great lengths to mask their crimes, investigators must step up the challenge and remain forever undaunted.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Dosage
programme.desc: Toxicology: While drugs can cure disease and ease pain, they can also be agents of murder. Toxicologists can examine blood and tissue to uncover cases where death is not as natural as it may seemfrom slow arsenic poisoning to quick cocaine overdoses.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Witness To Terror
programme.desc: Black Boxes: Little evidence is left after an airplane takes a deadly plunge from the sky. Investigators' best hope for an answer comes from the flight data recorder known as a black box.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder For Hire
programme.desc: For some killers, murder can be a profitable business. And the scene of the crime can be both a source for clues, and puzzling questions. When a victim has been targeted for death, investigators must look beyond the obvious to uncover a murder for hire.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Thackray Medical Museum
programme.desc: Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters investigate Thackray Medical Museum, believed to one of Leeds most haunted buildings. Workers claim to have witnessed constant paranormal activity in the museum and one claim is that two Victorian ghosts are trapped...

programme.title: Past Hunters: Ordsall Hall
programme.desc: Ordsall Hall is over 820 years old. It has been put to many uses including a family home, working men's club and church hall. With over 15 hauntings and many sightings, Ordsall Hall will certainly keep the team busy.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Tutbury Castle
programme.desc: The team head to Tutbury Castle in Derbyshire to investigate the paranormal reports at the location. Past Hunters appear to have caught the Tutbury Ghost on camera.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Carnfield Hall
programme.desc: Carnfield Hall is a country house dating from the 15th and 16th Centuries. This private residence turn event hall is using its paranormal activity to draw in business. Are these spirits the old residents?

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Further immersing themselves into Harlan county, the team investigates an active coal mine, Portal 31, and speaks with its manager about his own paranormal claims both inside the mine and in Lynch, Kentucky.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butikkmedarbeider oppdager en mystisk plante med en blodtørstig appetitt. Suksess følger, men prisen viser seg å være menneskeliv, og situasjonen eskalerer.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: Dark Star NO
programme.desc: Det er midten av 2000-tallet, og mennesket har utforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forlatt jorden for å finne nye hjem i universet. Det væpnede romskipet "Dark Star" skal bane vei for alle de fredelige kolonistene.

programme.title: Van Gogh At Eternity's Gate
programme.desc: De fleste synes kunsten hans er galskap, og når Vincent gir sitt eget avkuttede øre til en kvinne mener de at han også er gal. På en institusjon møter Vincent en prest, og sammen forsøker de å finne ut av hvorfor han er så misforstått.

programme.title: Ondt blod i sauedalen
programme.desc: Colin og Les avler prisvinnende sauer på en gård i et lite australsk samfunn. Når en sykdom sprer seg blant dyrene og myndighetene bestemmer at alle sauene i dalen må avlives, må mennene samarbeide for å redde levebrødet.

programme.title: Legal Action
programme.desc: Den dyktige advokaten Casey McKay blir hentet ut til en liten by av sin ekskone for å forsvare broren, anklaget for å ha drept en lovmann. Han oppdager et nett av intriger der han ender ansikt til ansikt med byens mest korrupte entreprenør, Mr. Gates.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: Når en klok svart hustler fra South Central i Los Angeles finner seg transportert tilbake til middelalderens England, leder han styrtingen av en ond konge og vinner hjertet til en protofeministisk kvinne.

programme.title: Hot Rod
programme.desc: En komedie om en stuntmann som aldri har greid å lande uten å besvime og om forsøket på å mestre sitt livs største stunt.

programme.title: Two Is Family
programme.desc: Samuel har et bekymringsløst liv på den franske rivieraen. Det er før Kristin, en tidligere flamme, kunngjør at han er far til en nyfødt, gir ham en babyjente og stikker!

programme.title: Parker
programme.desc: En kompromissløs mestertyv blir forrådt av medhjelperne og overlatt for å dø. Han utgir seg for å være en annen og samarbeider med en kvinne på innsiden for å sikre seg det seneste kuppet til gjengen.

programme.title: 97 Minutes
programme.desc: Et kapret fly vil styrte om bare 97 minutter når det går tom for drivstoff. NSA-direktøren vil at flyet skal skytes ned før den tid, og overlater skjebnen til de uskyldige passasjerene til en hemmelig Interpol-agent.

programme.title: True Colors
programme.desc: Mens Tim drømte om å jobbe i justisdepartementet, ønsket Peter å bli en sterk politisk aktør - for enhver pris.

programme.title: Paris, Texas
programme.desc: Paris, Texas er antagelig Wim Wenders mest kjente, kritikerroste og suksessfulle film, belønnet med flere internasjonale priser inkludert Gullpalmen i Cannes i 1984. Filmen forteller historien om Travis, en mann fortapt i sitt eget private helvete.

programme.title: Andromeda: Inn i labyrinten
programme.desc: En avgrunnsagent prøver å lokke Harper til å bli med i Magog

programme.title: Andromeda: Prinsen
programme.desc: Når de redder en ung prins fra et opprør som dreper resten av familien hans, blir Dylan og Tyr bedt om å være hans rådgivere.

programme.title: Mutant X: Crossroads of the Soul
programme.desc: Teamet tar sikte på å redde Brennan, som har blitt fanget inne i en usynlig by og står overfor henrettelse for en forbrytelse han ikke begikk.

programme.title: Mutant X: Sign from Above
programme.desc: Tre utenomjordiske personer som utgjør en alvorlig trussel mot menneskeheten, retter seg mot Shalimar, så teamet satser på å redde henne fra sine onde klør.

programme.title: Mutant X: Body and Soul
programme.desc: En kroppsløs mutant overtar likene til forskjellige mennesker og setter seg for å gå etter de som gjorde dette mot ham. En av dem er en lege som Shalimar liker.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dead Run
programme.desc: In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.

programme.title: The FBI Files: First and Kennedy Street Crew
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Coffee Shop Murders
programme.desc: At a coffee shop in Washington, DC, three employees were shot to death. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong or an act of cold-blooded vengeance?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dishonored
programme.desc: Shirley Russell was determined enough to reach the rank of Captain in the United States Marine Corps. When this officer turned up missing, her colleagues refused to believe she had gone AWOL. It was unclear whether Captain Shirley Russell was alive.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Buried Secrets
programme.desc: Forensic scientists find clues written in blood as they investigate the deaths of three women killed by the men who once loved them.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Aim
programme.desc: Ballistic analysis is the key to finding killers who turn guns on their victims. Each shot fired leaves its own "fingerprint", allowing scientists to target murderers with deadly aim.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bad Medicine
programme.desc: Drug trafficking has spawned a violent and deadly criminal underground. It's providing a challenge to forensic investigators devoted to cracking drug rings.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Deadly Smile
programme.desc: Investigators rely on forensic odontology to identify a body from a single tooth and to catch two brutal killers from their bite marks.

programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head get to look at real nudes. / The return of Lolita and Tanqueray! Beavis and Butt-head go on their first date, well, almost.

programme.title: Mike Judge's Beavis & Butt-Head: To teite menn / Fredagsgalskap
programme.desc: Middelaldrende Beavis og Butt-Head oppfyller sin samfunnsplikt som jurymedlemmer./ Beavis og Butt-Head tror feilaktig at de har byttet kropp.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Car Wash / Kidnapped
programme.desc: Beavis & Butt-head attempt to make some money washing cars. / Beavis & Butt-head decide that kidnapping Stewart would be a quick way to some cash.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Politically Correct / True Crime
programme.desc: To better understand their female classmates, Beavis & Butt-head must get in touch with their feelings. Huh huh, he said "touch." / Beavis & Butt-head unknowingly star in their favorite crime reenactment shows.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Follow me / Nothing happening / Take a lap
programme.desc: Beavis starts mimicing Butt-Head / A quiet day in Highland, Texas / Our duo enrolls in a fitness class

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Scared Straight / Citizen Butt-head Part 2
programme.desc: To teach them that crime doesn't pay, Beavis & Butt-head's principal sends them to prison for a day. Bad idea. / Beavis & Butt-head and President Clinton explore chaos theory together.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Sporting goods / Cow tipping
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-Head decide to get athletic gear supporters for gym class / The duo venture out on a quest for cow tipping

programme.title: Mike Judge's Beavis & Butt-Head: Den rare jenta / Tidsreisen
programme.desc: Beavis møter en hemmelig beundrer på skolen./ Beavis og Butt-Head krysser frem og tilbake over delstatslinjen inn i Mountain Time Zone og tror de kan reise i tiden.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Manners Suck / Pipe Of Doom
programme.desc: Mr. Van Driessen gives his class a lesson in manners that no one will ever forget. He punches out the etiquette teacher. / Butt-head gets stuck in a construction site pipe, a la Baby Jessica.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Garcia's Secret Girlfriend
programme.desc: Dangle and the gang solve Reno's biggest mystery: who is Garcia's new girlfriend?

programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Son
programme.desc: While Dangle spends time with a beautiful young man who might be his son, the other deputies enjoy the new department Humvee.

programme.title: RENO 911!: CSI: Reno
programme.desc: The deputies work as security guards when "CSI: Miami" comes to Reno, and Wiegel and Dangle get a homeless man into a bathtub.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Naked Stake-Out
programme.desc: After a drug sting goes wrong, Dangle and Junior race back to the station on foot -- and naked.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Wiegel and Craig Get Married
programme.desc: Good news and bad news for Wiegel: her boyfriend proposed, but he's going to be executed for multiple murders.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Wiegel's Pregnant
programme.desc: Did Dangle and Garcia freeze to death? Did Wiegel's serial killer husband get lethally injected? What is Carrot Top doing in Reno, and why is he so mad?

programme.title: RENO 911!: The Junior Bros.
programme.desc: While Garcia goes undercover to bust undocumented workers and the people who hire them, Junior spends his day off with his brothers.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Jet Ski Blues
programme.desc: The Reno Sheriff's Department inherits a beautiful, cursed jet ski from a fallen deputy.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Rick's On It
programme.desc: Rick the Citizens' Patrolman one-ups the Sheriff's Department in investigating a crime spree, and Garcia receives a visit from an old, unpredictable friend.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nightmare at 20,000 Feet
programme.desc: Mr. Wilson believes he sees a gremlin on the wing of the commercial aircraft he is taking back home... from the sanitarium, where he has been committed for six months after a mental breakdown during a similar flight.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Night Call
programme.desc: Mysterious phone calls haunt a disabled woman.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nervous Man in a Four Dollar Room
programme.desc: Small time criminal Jackie Rhoades must face both his past and his conscience while waiting for his next assignment.

programme.title: The Stepford Wives
programme.desc: En kvinne flytter inn i et nabolag der en gruppe ektemenn har gjort konene sine til roboter som er designet for å ta vare på dem. Nyinnspilling av filmen fra 1975.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Benham, Kentucky’s idyllic, small-town aesthetic belies its dark and bloody past, rife with greed and conflict. There are many who believe the community is living under the shadow of a mountain that bore witness to an evil supernatural occurrence.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Brandon, Mustafa, Malia, and Kevin engage in a roundtable discussion highlighting their most shocking finds and new data that they’ve gathered across their numerous investigations.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: A longtime grudge between two families linked by a brutal mob revenge killing persists in the historic Scott County Jail, whose current caretakers have transformed it into a paranormal research center.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: CoCo
programme.desc: Coco Austin (Model/Dancer/Reality show star) returns to her former home in Albuquerque, NM where as a teenager, she was tormented by a dark entity. While exploring the house and its assembled spirits.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Jack Blades
programme.desc: Jack Blades (Night Ranger) returns to the site of the paranormal experience he had at his cousin's residence--an adobe style home in Alamogordo, New Mexico.

programme.title: The Raven (1963)
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: The Ghoul
programme.desc: A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead. The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

programme.title: What's Eating Gilbert Grape
programme.desc: Gilbert føler seg innesperret, i en kjedelig amerikansk småby, med ansvar for sin autistiske lillebror og bevegelseshemmete mor. Men en dag kommer Becky til byen, og snart oppstår det et skjørt og spesielt vennskap dem imellom.

programme.title: Orange County
programme.desc: Shaun trives som en smart, men ufokusert surfer, helt til han oppdager en roman av den anerkjente forfatteren Martin Skinner. Han blir inspirert, og forlater Orange County for å studere kreativ skriving ved Stanford University.

programme.title: Hackers
programme.desc: A neophyte hacker becomes the target of the FBI after he unknowingly taps into a high-tech embezzling scheme which could cause a horrific environmental disaster in this suspenseful drama.

programme.title: Fantomet
programme.desc: Historien begynner når en ekspedisjon går i land på øya Bengalla på leting etter Tougandas hodeskaller. Med sin evne til å styre energi kan de bli en katastrofe for menneskeheten.

programme.title: Impact Earth
programme.desc: En astronomiprofessor med NASA-bakgrunn gjør en skremmende oppdagelse om at en destruktiv asteroide er på kollisjonskurs med jorda, og han må få familien i trygghet mens han varsler verden om den kommende ødeleggelsen.

programme.title: A Merry Holiday
programme.desc: Christy, en svært vellykket selger, stresser med å få en stor avtale. For å hjelpe henne må hun slå seg sammen med Jonathan som er opptatt med å lage en magisk jul for kjæresten sin. Konflikten er gitt, men noe annet begynner også å gry...

programme.title: Disaster Movie
programme.desc: DISASTER MOVIE fortsetter den komiske nedturen til din yndlingsgruppe med latterlig attraktive 20-åringer. En skjebnesvanger natt prøver de å komme seg i trygghet mens enhver kjent naturkatastrofe, knuser byen og deres vei.

programme.title: Fortress
programme.desc: Den tidligere CIA-agenten Robert bor på et hemmelig feriested for tidligere spioner. Nå er hans sønn Paul havnet i trøbbel og trenger hans hjelp. Dessverre er ikke Pauls planer så hemmelige som livet til faren.

programme.title: The Ice Road
programme.desc: Etter at en fjerntliggende diamantgruve kollapser i Nord-Canada tar Mike oppdraget med å lede redningsoperasjonen, og må trosse de brutale naturkreftene i Canadas villmark.

programme.title: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
programme.desc: Velkommen til en katolsk jenteskole i hjertet av Chicago, hjemstedet til USAs favorittdanseshow: Dance TV! Utvekslingsstudenten Janey Glenn er et nervevrak når hun blir introdusert for sine fnisende klassekamerater av den strenge søster Katherine.

programme.title: Wim Wenders Collection: Far Away So Close
programme.desc: En gruppe engler i den tyske hovedstaden ser med lengsel på menneskers liv.

programme.title: Mutant X: Understudy
programme.desc: Mens han er på jobb, blir Shalimar skadet og blir hjulpet av en annen vill mutant, Nikki, som hun kjente og nesten ble valgt for laget. Mens Shalimar blir frisk, tilbyr hun å fylle ut.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Three Rivers to Cross
programme.desc: Ifølge lokale munker er Famed Jade Empress gjemt i dalen som vil bli oversvømmet når Three Rivers Dam flomportene har sin store åpning.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Lost Contact
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel og milliardærentreprenør Rod Thorson fallskjerm i Myanmar-jungelen for å redde et relikktjaktteam ansatt av Thorson for å finne en eldgammel offerskål.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Cross of Voodoo
programme.desc: Når to studenter på sporet av det haitiske korset i Utu forsvinner i New Orleans, går Sydney og Nigel ned på bukten for å finne dem.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Roman Holiday
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel er på tur, så Claudia bestemmer seg for å hjelpe Sydneys venn Roger med å finne Julius Cæsars rustning, men relikktjakt er ikke hennes talent.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Evil Intent
programme.desc: Drops of blood and a torn screen were all that's left to tell authorities what happened to a woman in Indiana. The 21 yr. old victim was taken from her home on a spring morning. She appeared to have no real enemies, there was no clear motive.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: When Seconds Count
programme.desc: On July 2nd 1994, a 12-year-old girl was abducted from her home in northern California. The FBI knows to act fast, search wide, enlist volunteers. But as the hours slipped by, agents also realized their chances for recovering her alive grew slim.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Vanished
programme.desc: A daring kidnapping and a bizarre ransom note baffled Mississippi authorities. The victim was the wife of a wealthy businessman. A list of 12 names and a few drops of blood were the only clues to her fate.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Misplaced Loyalty
programme.desc: In Northern California, a fire rages in the middle of the night. A woman's charred body is discovered in the smoldering aftermath.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Poisoners are the most devious of killers, relying on stealth or their victim's trust in order to steal their lives. They're the most dangerous creatures in the world: smart assassins. And they usually don't stop at one kill.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Left At The Scene
programme.desc: The tiniest residue left at the scene can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Seeds of Destruction
programme.desc: Forensic Botany & Geology: Plants help provide oxygen and nutrients for existence. Soil is the fertilizer of life. Yet both can yield clues to the time and location of a person's death.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Sympathy and The Engagement
programme.desc: A couple is mysteriously poisoned on their first night in a new home. A woman fears the horrifying activity in her home could be related to an antique her fiance purchased.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Hazel and House of Sacrifice
programme.desc: All hell breaks loose after a couple takes in a troubled foster child. A family struggles to come to terms with the events that happened in their basement.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Patti Stanger
programme.desc: Millionaire Matchmaker Patti Stanger reluctantly returns to her former dream home in Marina Del Rey where she was attacked in her bed by an aggressive spirit.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Audrina Patridge
programme.desc: Reality star and host Audrina Patridge returns to an historic pub in Chicago where she was accosted by an angry spirit. Their journey takes an unexpected turn as Psycic Medium Kim Russo uncovers more of Audrina's story.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: 10 Items or Less
programme.desc: Oscar®-vinnaren Morgan Freeman spelar här en filmstjärna som ger sig ut på rollförberedande research i ett snabbköp i Los Angeles. Han möter en snabbtalande kassörska och de ger sig av på en gemensam resa för att visa varandra sina respektive världar.

programme.title: Fast Girls
programme.desc: En gatsmart sprintertjej får en bitter rival i sin minst lika ambitiösa men rikare lagkamrat i detta sexiga, kaxiga, vilda och fartfyllda drama med massor av romantik, konflikter och den nervpirrande jakten på guldet.

programme.title: White Oleander
programme.desc: I ett anfall av sjuklig svartsjuka förgiftar den kompromisslösa och förföriska konstnären Ingrid sin älskare. Hon döms till livstids fängelse och hennes 15-åriga dotter Astrid får därefter flytta runt mellan olika fosterfamiljer.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Las Vegas, a gang of robbers target an ATM repository and hit the jackpot. Their take was over a million dollars in cash, the largest heist in Las Vegas history.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Millionaire Murder
programme.desc: A businessman went to Florida to make one last deal before he retired-he never returned home to his millions. Authorities examined who was closest to him and who stood to gain from his disappearance. But this time conventional rules didn't apply.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Georgia, a series of bizarre shootings terrorized a small town. Two people were killed. Two others were critically wounded. At first, the shootings seemed targeted. Then they seemed random.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In this special episode, we take a closer look at cases previously featured on this series. Our goal is to explore more fully some of the investigative methods and techniques that have made the FBI the premier law enforcement agency in the world.

programme.title: Donovan'S Reef
programme.desc: The Duke, Lee Marvin and Jack Warden play navy buddies that made the French Polynesian island of Haleakaloha their post-war paradise. Local headquarters is Donovan's Reef, Wayne's watering hole.

programme.title: Taken 2
programme.desc: Den pensionerade CIA-agenten Bryan Mills och hans fru är i Istanbul när de blir kidnappade. Mannen som håller dom som gisslan visar sig vara far till en av de män som tidigare kidnappat Mills dotter, och som han under fritagandet av dottern dödat.

programme.title: Taken 3
programme.desc: Liam Neeson är tillbaka som Bryan Mills. Men denna gång är det han själv som hamnar i knipa då han blir jagad för ett mord han inte begått.

programme.title: Paris, Texas
programme.desc: Filmen berättar historien om Travis, en man vilse i sitt eget privata helvete. Förmodad död i fyra år, dyker han en dag upp i öknen, trött och med minnesförlust.

programme.title: Mitt namn är fortfarande Nobody
programme.desc: Terence Hill har fått miljoner svenska biobesökare att jubla! Först kom Trinity, sedan Nobody. Nu är Terence Hill tillbaka som Joe Thanks, den galnaste och snabbaste revolvermannen i vilda västern.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Antianeirai
programme.desc: Sydney och Nigel reser till Istanbul för att undersöka döden hos en av Sydneys vänner, en professor som försökte bevisa att Herkules existerade genom att hitta Hippolytes bälte.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Under isen
programme.desc: Trots det hemska vädret tar Sidney med sig Nigel till en arktisk bas där man har hittat en gammal indiansk mumie som visar sig vara en Anasazi.

programme.title: Andromeda: Och ditt hjärta kommer att flyga iväg
programme.desc: När en förlorad kärlek återvänder försvinner Tyr från skeppet för att skydda henne från en lönnmördare.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den oövervinneliga mannen
programme.desc: Den utspelar sig i ett alternativt universum där Dylan dog och Gaheris Rhade försöker reformera Samväldet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Delenda Est
programme.desc: Gruppen som attackerade Andromeda under det första undertecknandet av Samväldets stadgar återvänder för att ställa till med mer förödelse.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Misplaced Loyalty
programme.desc: In Northern California, a fire rages in the middle of the night. A woman's charred body is discovered in the smoldering aftermath.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead In The Water
programme.desc: Drowning deaths often look like accidents and water can destroy the scant clues the killer may have left behind. Investigators must turn to forensic science to solve cases where the victim is found dead in the water.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Without A Trace
programme.desc: Missing Person: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Worldwide, the number of missing persons nearly triples.

programme.title: The New Detectives: For Love Or Money
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When money is the motive, murder can rip at the very foundation of marriage and family.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: All in the Family
programme.desc: Al's quiet three-day weekend plans to watch his favorite John Wayne movie "Hondo" are ruined when Peggy's eccentric relatives come to visit the Bundy household.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Camping Show (aka A Period Piece)
programme.desc: Steve, Marcy and the Bundys head out to Steve and Marcy's cabin in the woods, but the merriment is halted by Kelly's PMS. The men leave for a bit to go out fishing, and return to all three women menstruating and hostile.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: He Thought He Could
programme.desc: Al discovers a library book that was due in 1957. He must return it to the library and face up to his worst childhood fear: the librarian.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: I'm Going to Sweatland
programme.desc: When a perspiration stain on one of Al's shirts resembles a silhouette of The King of Rock & Roll, the Bundy household becomes a hot spot for Elvis Presley fanatics to visit.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Poke High (aka The Red Grange Story)
programme.desc: A young football player, named Matt, from Polk High where Kelly and Bud go to school is threatening two Bundy records. One held by Al for the most touchdowns in one season, and the other by Kelly for refusing her advances.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: A Dump of My Own
programme.desc: Al decides to build a spare bathroom when the upstairs toilet floods one too many times.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Her Cups Runneth Over
programme.desc: Al must go to a far-off lingerie outlet store to buy a discontinued brassiere for Peggy.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Bald and the Beautiful
programme.desc: Desperate Al and Steve put their heads together seeking solutions to impending baldness.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: I'll See You in Court
programme.desc: In the infamous 'lost episode', Al and Peg learn they have been video-taped getting intimate at a sleazy motel. The same thing has also happened to Steve and Marcy. They decide to take the matter to court.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Murder Site / Sexual Harassment
programme.desc: Beavis can't take Butt-head's verbal abuse anymore, and snaps while they're checking out the site of a local murder. / Beavis and Butt-head sue Kimberly for sexual harassment, since she's giving them wood.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Take a number / Stewart moves away / Premature evacuation
programme.desc: The duo goes to rock concert / Beavis and Butt-Head breaks into Stewarts house to watch TV / A bomb threat is called into their high school

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: A great day / Bride of Butt-Head / Special delivery
programme.desc: The school closes and makes the best day / Butt-Head phones in a mail-order bride / Burger World launches a home delivery service

programme.desc: Butt-Head får medicin för sin aggressivitet mot Beavis och blir lite för snäll./ Medelålders Beavis och Butt-Head får slut på ölpengar, så Beavis måste skaffa ett jobb.

programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head win a radio contest and become disc jockeys for a day. / During a sugar rush, Beavis' alter ego appears. He reeks havoc at Highland High looking for "teepee for his bunghole."

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Car Wash / Kidnapped
programme.desc: Beavis & Butt-head attempt to make some money washing cars. / Beavis & Butt-head decide that kidnapping Stewart would be a quick way to some cash.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Woodshop / T.V. Violence / Canned / Garage band
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-Head take woodworking class / Stevensons get a sattelite dish / An unopened can puts our duo to new adventures / Beavis and Butt-Head form a band called Metallica

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Buy Beer / Just For Girls
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head get drunk off non-alcoholic beer and fail a sobriety test. / Beavis and Butt-head are allowed to watch a film for girls about teen pregnancy. The titillation ends abruptly during the birthing sequence.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Back in Black
programme.desc: Dangle reconnects with his family after his estranged father passes away.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Undercover at Burger Cousin
programme.desc: Rick the Burger Cousin manager is a cruel taskmaster when deputies go undercover flipping burgers.

programme.title: RENO 911!: The Wall
programme.desc: Garcia and Junior help build a wall to keep Mexicans from crossing into America illegally.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Death of a Pickle-Thrower
programme.desc: Jackie, the pickle-throwing hooker, spends her twilight hours with the Reno Sheriff's Department.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Baghdad 911

programme.title: RENO 911!: The Tanning Booth Incident

programme.title: RENO 911!: Strong Sister

programme.title: RENO 911!: Wiegel's Dad Returns
programme.desc: While the deputies investigate Reno's Thai sex trade, Wiegel's long-lost father returns to reconnect with his daughter.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Junior Runs for Office

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Last Flight
programme.desc: A World War I flying ace flies through a mysterious cloud - and lands at a modern U.S. airbase in the year 1959!

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: I Sing the Body Electric
programme.desc: A widower buys a robot grandmother for his three children.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Quality of Mercy
programme.desc: A gung-ho young soldier gets a new viewpoint on war when he inexplicably changes places with a Japanese officer trying to stop his superior from leading a charge against American forces.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Bevis
programme.desc: An eccentric loser gets a new life from his guardian angel, but there is a price to keeping it.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Number Twelve Looks Just Like You
programme.desc: In a future where everyone must undergo an operation at the age of 19 to make them identical to everyone else, one woman desperately tries to hang onto her own identity.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Spur of the Moment
programme.desc: After being chased on horseback by a terrifying, unidentified figure in black, Anne Henderson faces the biggest decision of her life.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Deaths-Head Revisited
programme.desc: A former Nazi SS Captain returns to the ruins of a concentration camp to reminisce and is met by one of his victims.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Fever
programme.desc: Tight-fisted Franklin Gibbs is not pleased when his wife wins a trip for two to Las Vegas. But things change when he falls under the spell of a slot machine that calls his name.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: T-Pain
programme.desc: Music Mogul and rapper T-Pain seeks psychic medium Kim Russo's help in uncovering what is causing the terrifying paranormal activity in his family's home in Roswell, Georgia.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Karina Smirnoff
programme.desc: Psychic Medium Kim Russo helps Dancing With The Stars Karina Smirnoff confront the ghosts who are terrorizing her family in their Woodland Hills, California home.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: A longtime grudge between two families linked by a brutal mob revenge killing persists in the historic Scott County Jail, whose current caretakers have transformed it into a paranormal research center.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Brandon, Mustafa, Malia, and Kevin engage in a roundtable discussion highlighting their most shocking finds and new data that they’ve gathered across their numerous investigations.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Benham, Kentucky’s idyllic, small-town aesthetic belies its dark and bloody past, rife with greed and conflict. There are many who believe the community is living under the shadow of a mountain that bore witness to an evil supernatural occurrence.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksanställd upptäcker en mystisk växt med en blodtörstig aptit. Framgång följer, men priset visar sig vara människoliv, och situationen eskalerar.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: Boulevard: Boulevard
programme.desc: En tråkig bankman (Robin Williams) utmanas när han oväntat tar en ny riktning i livet och väljer kärleken.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: En inspirerande berättelse om basketcoachen Ken Carter, som fick både kritik och beröm när han skapade rubriker efter att han bänkat hela sitt obesegrade lag på grund av deras dåliga studieresultat.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1980s, the United States faced a deadly new enemy abroad, an expanding network of terrorists targeting American interests. Hundreds of innocent people were killed in bombings, executions, and hijackings.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Takeover
programme.desc: Two armed bank robbers hit a Seattle bank taking over 150,000 dollars. Before they can escape police confront them and the pair splits up. As authorities search block by block they learn one was a career criminal with a long history of violence.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A criminal who kills a police officer wages war on society. In 1987 such a criminal vanished after shooting two Boston officers, one fatally. He had a history of violence against cops and the protection of a group of outlaws.

programme.title: I morgon börjar allt
programme.desc: Samuel, en man vars bekymmerslösa liv på Franska Rivieran vänds upp och ner när Kristin, som han haft en kortare romans med, plötsligt dyker upp och presenterar honom för deras nyfödda dotter Gloria. Kristin överlämnar Gloria med varm hand i hans vårdnad.

programme.title: Jackass: The Movie
programme.desc: Med scener som aldrig skulle visas i TV! Stollarna från MTV-serien "Jackass" är tillbaka med stuntsm som ingen skulle låta dem göra i TV.

programme.title: TAKEN
programme.desc: Bryan, en före detta CIA-agent har svårt att släppa sin gamla yrkesroll och ser faror överallt. När hans dotter, Kim, åker till Paris, besannas hans värsta mardröm, hon kidnappas.

programme.title: The Big White
programme.desc: För att lindra sina ekonomiska problem söker en anställd på en resebyrå efter ett fruset lik, som råkar vara eftertraktat av två mördare.

programme.title: Poupelle of Chimney Town
programme.desc: Poupelle från Chimney Town är berättelsen om den unge Lubicchi som lever bland denU+000Atjocka röken från skorstenarna i sin isolerade stad och längtar efter att se “stjärnorna” veta sanningen som hans far alltid berättat om för honom

programme.title: Supersnutarna
programme.desc: Matt och Wilbur är två hårdslående bråkmakare, men med hjärtat på rätta stället. Efter ett misslyckat rånförsök i Miami hamnar de av misstag på stadens polisskola.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det mörka bakåt
programme.desc: Trance går igenom ett antal olika scenarier och försöker hitta ett där hennes besättningskamrater inte dör.

programme.title: Mutant X: Ingen utfart
programme.desc: En mutant som har förmågan att interfasera med vilken dator som helst med sitt sinne, som är förlamad efter ett möte med teamet, tar över Sanctuarys datorer.

programme.title: Mutant X: Väktare
programme.desc: Mutant X-teamet får veta mer om Lexas tvillingbror när han blir huvudmåltavla för en underjordisk verksamhet som skördar mutantorgan.

programme.title: Mutant X: Möjligheter
programme.desc: Brennan och Mutant X-teamet går samman med en tidsresande mutant för att desarmera en bomb som hotar att få förödande konsekvenser.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Left At The Scene
programme.desc: The tiniest residue left at the scene can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Witness To Terror
programme.desc: Black Boxes: Little evidence is left after an airplane takes a deadly plunge from the sky. Investigators' best hope for an answer comes from the flight data recorder known as a black box.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Obsessions
programme.desc: Some people will let nothing stand between them and their goals. In their tortured minds, raw desire replaces all reason, and homicide becomes a convenient means to an end.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Dosage
programme.desc: Toxicology: While drugs can cure disease and ease pain, they can also be agents of murder. Toxicologists can examine blood and tissue to uncover cases where death is not as natural as it may seemfrom slow arsenic poisoning to quick cocaine overdoses.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Eatin' Out

programme.title: Våra värsta år: My Mom, the Mom
programme.desc: Kelly invites Peggy to her school as part of a presentation for career day.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: A Three Job, No Income Family

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Harder They Fall

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The House That Peg Lost

programme.title: RENO 911!: Undercover Acting Coach
programme.desc: Sergeant Clift, the LAPD's undercover acting coach, teaches the deputies the subtle art of theater.

programme.title: RENO 911!: The Parade
programme.desc: The Carson City Parade Float Contest brings out the deputies' competitive spirit.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Training Day
programme.desc: Jones adjusts to his new partner's unorthodox style, and Wiegel and Williams enjoy some surprisingly delicious racist wines.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Extradition to Thailand!
programme.desc: Junior and Jones reap the benefits that come from extraditing a murderer, and Dangle and Rizzo receive a surprise crash course in surgery.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Digging with the Murderer
programme.desc: Dangle and Williams haggle with a serial killer to get him to reveal where he buried his victims.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Murder Mystery, Pt. 1
programme.desc: Dangle invites the gang to a Reno's Sierra Historical Society dinner -- and a murder.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Murder Mystery, Pt. 2
programme.desc: Who murdered Debbie Dangle, and how does her death tie into the deputies' sordid past?

programme.title: RENO 911!: We Don't Want the Pope
programme.desc: The deputies provide the pope's advance scouting team with an extensive tour of Reno's seedy side.

programme.title: RENO 911!: VHS Transfer Memory Lane
programme.desc: Rizzo and Wiegel pervert-proof the Washoe County Library computers.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Living Doll
programme.desc: Erich is displeased when his wife buys an expensive doll for his step-daughter. He becomes even more displeased when the doll tells him it doesn't like him!

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Chaser
programme.desc: A man, desperate to win the affection of a beautiful woman, slips her a love potion. He is overjoyed that the potion works so well...at first.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A World of His Own
programme.desc: A playwright makes characters come to life.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Kick the Can
programme.desc: The senior residents of Sunnyvale decide that the secret to youth is acting young, and in particular playing a childhood game called "kick-the-can."

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Howling Man
programme.desc: Seeking refuge from a storm, traveler David Ellington comes upon a bizarre hermitage of monks, who have imprisoned a man who begs for his help. When David confronts the head monk Brother Jerome, he is told that the man is the devil, and David must decide

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Long Distance Call
programme.desc: A toy telephone becomes the link between a young boy and his dead grandmother.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Man in the Bottle
programme.desc: A luckless couple stumbles upon fortune when a genie materializes from a bottle in their antique shop. The genie grants them four wishes but warns them, prophetically, to be careful what you wish for.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Jeopardy Room
programme.desc: Major Ivan Kuchenko is trapped inside a hotel room with Commissar Vassiloff, a hitman, and Boris, his assistant, in the room across the street. Vassiloff has planted a bomb in the room and Ivan must find it within three hours or be blown to bits.
